meta.title: {{brand}} engine console
meta.description: Console for the operators of the {{brand}} social engine: networks, moderation teams, federation and audit log.

home.title: {{brand}} engine console
home.lead: Manage networks, teams and engine operations.
home.access: Restricted to authorised operators signing in with IDN.

session.backendMissing: The engine is not configured for this console.
session.signedOut: You are not signed in to the engine.
session.noAuthority: An IDN identity at level {{level}} or above and a current operator authorisation are required. You can sign in with IDN again.
session.globalSignOutFailed: The local session was closed, but revocation on other devices could not be confirmed.
session.localSignOutFailed: Local cleanup could not be completed. Reload the page and check your session.
session.denied: Console access is not authorised for this session.

signIn.title: Sign in to the console
signIn.help: Use your authorised IDN identity to access engine tools.
signIn.unavailable: IDN sign-in for this console is not configured yet. The owner must create and configure its OIDC client.
signIn.minimum: IDN level {{level}} minimum. Signing in does not create an authorisation.

common.loadFailed: Data could not be loaded. Your permissions have not changed.
common.actionFailed: The action could not be confirmed. Your input has been kept; try again.
common.pendingNavigation: A decision is in progress. Wait for its result before changing views.

console.networkHint: Network-specific tools use this selection. Audit logs and health cover the engine.

networks.lead: Manage networks and their policies here. Archiving retains the data.
networks.createHint: A child network becomes available without deployment. Choose generic admission unless the DIASPORALE slice is required.
networks.settingsHint: The identifier and admission type are fixed at creation. Every change to settings has a reason and is recorded.
networks.readOnly: Settings are available for review. Only administrators may edit active networks.
networks.leaveConfirm: Leave this form and discard unsaved changes?
networks.unavailable: This network is no longer available in this list.
networks.bounded: The list is limited to 200 active and 200 archived networks, plus the root.
networks.invalid: Check this field's value and limits.
networks.facetInvalid: The facet JSON schema does not match the contract: typed fields, admitted visibility and no more than 24 fields.
networks.countryInvalid: Use only two-letter uppercase ISO country codes separated by commas.
networks.reasonRequired: The reason must contain between 10 and 500 characters.
networks.slugHint: 3 to 32 characters: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, with no double hyphen. The identifier is immutable.
networks.policyHint: Open: generic admission; declared or verified: status rules; mirror: signed projections only.
networks.visibilityHint: Distribution to the root remains subject to a public audience and publication rules.
networks.valuesHint: Distinct comma-separated values; up to 50 values of 80 characters each.
networks.countryHint: ISO alpha-2 codes (GA, FR…) separated by commas. Empty: no declared countries. The admission slice determines their effect.
networks.themeHint: Identifier of an installed theme: {{themes}}. An identifier alone does not install a theme.
networks.managedHint: The DIASPORALE slice applies its own admission rules. This choice is fixed at creation and does not recreate an existing DIASPORALE network.
networks.facetHint: Empty: no facet. Closed JSON { fields: […] }: key, kind, required and defaultVisibility. Arbitrary values will not be submitted.
networks.reasonHint: 10 to 500 characters. The reason is recorded in the decision log.

archive.title: Archive with two-person approval
archive.help: The root cannot be archived. For this network, a proposal with a reason must be approved by a different authorised person. No data is deleted.
archive.requested: The archive proposal was recorded. It awaits a different authorised person.
archive.approved: The network was archived after two-person approval.
archive.own: Your proposal awaits a second approval.
archive.expired: This proposal expired; a new request is required.
